configure_train_output_dir: set the training output directory path in the train config dict
configure_train_max_iter: set the maximum number of training iterations in the train config dict
configure_amp_mixed_precision: enable or disable automatic mixed precision training in the train config dict
configure_ddp_settings: configure DistributedDataParallel options like broadcast_buffers and fp16_compression in the train config
configure_checkpointer_settings: set the PeriodicCheckpointer period and max_to_keep values in the train config dict
